    public addRecurringFreeDays(options: Object, id: Number | String): Promise source 

    import {addRecurringFreeDays} from 'insales/lib/api/recurringcharge.js'

    PATCH /admin/recurring_application_charge/add_free_days.json

    Examples:

     insales.addRecurringFreeDays({
   token: '1234567890',
   url: 'shop-test.myinsales.ru',
   recurring: {
     "recurring_application_charge": {
       "days_count": 21
     }
   }
 }).then(response => {
   console.info(response.data);
 }).catch(err => {
   console.error(err);
 });

    Output:

     {
   "monthly": "400.0",
   "trial_expired_at": "2026-11-19",
   "created_at": "2026-10-21T23:32:54.469+03:00",
   "updated_at": "2026-10-21T23:32:54.681+03:00",
   "paid_till": "2026-11-19",
   "blocked": false
 }

    NameTypeAttributeDescription
    options Object
    options.token string

    Required, access token for shop
    options.url string

    Required, shop url
    options.recurring object

    Required, recurring application charge
    id Number | String

    Required, app id

    Return:

     insales.createAccessoryValue({
   token: '1234567890',

   accessoryid: '92',
   accessoryvalue: {
     "accessory_value": {

    POST /admin/outlets.json

    Examples:

   url: 'shop-test.myinsales.ru',
   outlet: {

       "title": "Point 2",
       "description": "Point description",
       "address": "some address",
       "price": 300,
       "latitude": 55.7558,

    POST /admin/themes/#{theme_id}/widget_types.xml

    Examples:

     insales.uploadWidgetType({
   token: '1234567890',
   url: 'shop-test.myinsales.ru',
   theme: '643879',
   data: {

    'type': 'BlockListWidgetType', 'handle': 'widget_type_2', 'name': 'WidgetType 2', 'widget_category_handle': 'drugie', 'page_kinds': ['all'], 'widget_list_kinds': ['content'], 'block_template_handle': 'system-title-and-content' } }).then(output => { console.info(output.data); }).catch(err => { console.error(err); }); Output:

       {

    'type': 'BlockListWidgetType', 'handle': 'widget_type_2', 'name': 'WidgetType 2', 'widget_category_handle': 'drugie', 'page_kinds': ['all'], 'widget_list_kinds': ['content'], 'block_template_handle': 'system-title-and-content' }
